title: CEA Indian Grid Emission Factor
source: Central Electricity Authority, CO2 Baseline Database Version 21.0
text: The weighted-average emission factor for the Indian grid, including renewable generation, is 0.710 tCO2/MWh for FY 2024-25, equivalent to 0.710 kg CO2/kWh.

title: Average Car Reference Factor
text: The average car, unknown fuel, reference factor is 0.16664 kg CO2e per kilometre.

title: Average Motorbike Reference Factor
text: The average motorbike reference factor is approximately 0.11367 kg CO2e per kilometre.

title: Average Local Bus Reference Factor
text: The average local bus reference factor is approximately 0.10215 kg CO2e per passenger kilometre.

title: National Rail Reference Factor
text: The national rail reference factor is approximately 0.03546 kg CO2e per passenger kilometre.

title: Food Footprint Evidence
source: Our World in Data, Environmental Impacts of Food Production
text: Global food-system data show that meat and dairy products generally have higher greenhouse-gas footprints than plant-based foods. The dataset uses global averages and is based on the Poore and Nemecek meta-analysis.

title: Shopping Calculation Note
text: The shopping estimate in this student prototype is a simplified spend-based assumption. It is not presented as an official India-specific carbon factor.
